description: Search WIPO Pearl for a scientific, technical, or IP legal term. Each result is a concept record with its validated equivalents in every language (term, reliability rating, defining context, usage, source), optionally limited to target_languages. WIPO's own search matches on the FIRST WORD only, so a phrase that is not in Pearl still returns dozens of unrelated prefix hits; this tool withholds results where no term contains the whole query (match is "exact" or "contains") unless include_partial is true, and says how many it withheld. Example: pearl_search_terms({ term: "interleukin", target_languages: ["FR", "JA"] }).

_apiKey.description: Optional. Pipeworx supplies a WIPO Business Partner Portal credential automatically. Pass your own as JSON: '{"client_id":"...","client_secret":"..."}' to use a dedicated subscription instead.

exact_search.description: Match the search term exactly rather than fuzzily.

include_partial.description: Also return records where no term contains the whole query (WIPO prefix matches on the first word), marked match="partial". Default false.

limit.description: Maximum concept records to return (default 10, max 50).

source_language.description: ISO 639-1 language the term itself is in: AR, DE, EN, ES, FR, JA, KO, PT, RU, ZH. Omit to search across all languages.

subject_field.description: Restrict to one WIPO Pearl subject-field code (see pearl_subject_fields for the full list), e.g. "LEGL", "CHEM", "ELEC". Omit to search every field.

target_languages.description: ISO 639-1 languages to return equivalents in (subset of AR, DE, EN, ES, FR, JA, KO, PT, RU, ZH). Omit for all available.

term.description: The word or phrase to search for, e.g. "circuit" or "interleukin".

name: pearl_search_terms
title: Pearl Search Terms
